scope: Same-major Java security remediation, isolated local regression and exact-image rescan. No AWS provisioning or deployment.

initial_fixture_failure.cause: The isolated export initially omitted observability/personal/sql/db-query-cancel-one.sql required by an existing test. Corrected the export and working directory, not application code.

test_isolation.network: internal; runner shares only fixture network namespace to isolate hardcoded localhost tests

new_test_contracts.limitations: Local synthetic issuer and MVC regression tests; not an actual Cognito login or exploit reproduction.

database_codegen.limitation: Combined generateJooq+compileJava invocation hit existing Gradle implicit dependency guard; compiling in a separate invocation preserves explicit codegen workflow.

independent_review.review_scope: Independent artifact comparison, XML test aggregation, resolved dependency and image archive verification, and official vendor source review. No code changes or AWS execution.

evidence.public_evidence: Initial api-image-security-review.json and sections of this remediation artifact

comparison.package_identity: package name plus CVE; version intentionally excluded to compare upgrades
comparison.interpretation: 49 former Critical/High package findings are no longer detected in this runtime image with the comparison database. This is a scanner comparison, not an exploitability or not-affected determination.

scanner_comparison.same_cache_and_skip_updates: Execution parent reports both scans used this cache with skip-db-update and skip-java-db-update. Current cache download timestamps precede both reports. Commands were not re-executed by reviewer.
scanner_comparison.limitation: This controlled comparison is not a scan against a newly refreshed vulnerability database.

image_identity.limitation: Configured non-root user was verified from archive; reviewer did not execute the container or provision a server.

new_security_tests.scope: Local discovery/JWKS/signature/claim validation and SecurityFilterChain regression; not real Cognito or AWS E2E.

codegen_validation_artifact.limitation: Combined generateJooq+compileJava invocation hit existing Gradle implicit dependency guard; compiling in a separate invocation preserves explicit codegen workflow.

remaining_findings.conditions: XsltView with a catch-all MVC mapping that renders an implicit view name.
remaining_findings.decision: Review effective view configuration and a compatible supported Boot/Framework path before any major upgrade; no major upgrade was applied.
remaining_findings.disposition: open; not suppressed; no risk acceptance

remaining_findings.conditions: MVC/WebFlux sends view fragments over SSE and an attacker controls data streamed to other users.
remaining_findings.decision: Review actual SSE fragment handlers and explain upgrade alternatives before any major change.
remaining_findings.disposition: open; not suppressed; no risk acceptance

remaining_findings.vendor_severity: not independently established from accessible advisory text
remaining_findings.conditions: Classic HTTP content decompression handling can leak its response resource on unexpected runtime or protocol exceptions. Actual application reachability was not tested.
remaining_findings.source_note: Apache archive page exposed no advisory text through the browser; the upstream fix commit and 5.6.3 release/news were verified.
remaining_findings.decision: Future plan only: assess 5.5 to 5.6 minor upgrade, HttpCore/AWS SDK compatibility and outbound request regression tests; no further update performed.
remaining_findings.disposition: open; not suppressed; no risk acceptance

remaining_findings.conditions: A layout uses MapMessage JSON serialization and the application logs an attacker-controlled non-finite floating-point value. Actual application reachability was not tested.
remaining_findings.decision: Future plan only: inspect logging/bridge configuration, consider aligned Log4j 2.x modules, and test structured logs; no further update performed.
remaining_findings.disposition: open; not suppressed; no risk acceptance

source_applicability.observations: Prior source inspection found nine REST controllers and no explicit XSLT view, SSE view fragments or template resources; WebSocket handlers are a different mechanism.
source_applicability.limitation: Absence from source searches is not proof of non-reachability. Effective personal-profile context, handler mappings and external configuration still need focused validation. Avoid asserting all ViewResolver, catch-all mappings or ModelAndView must be absent.

build_classpath_scope.status: not certified by runtime-image vulnerability scan
build_classpath_scope.limitation: Buildscript/plugin, code generator and test classpaths differ from the runtime image. Version inventory and passing tests are not a separate vulnerability certification of these toolchains.

recommended_next_steps: Keep all four findings open and preserve scanner and vendor severities separately.
Review Framework applicability and explain Boot/Framework major upgrade versus supported 6.2 options before implementing a major change.
Treat the two Medium upgrades and any build-tool dependency scanning as follow-up plans; no additional code update is part of this review.
Before deployment approval, resolve or explicitly assess remaining findings and complete the separate deployment/authentication/environment gates.
completion_limits: Do not label all Java security work or application security complete.
Do not infer real exploitability from package version matching or passing regression tests.
Do not describe runtime-image High=0 as all build tools, CI, Cognito, or AWS being security-verified.
No AWS server creation, Terraform apply, ECR publication, or additional dependency update was performed by this reviewer.
